prompt: ___ libro es interesante. (My book is interesting.)
___ casa es grande. (Our house is big.)
hint: Nuestro/a agrees with the noun: casa is feminine.

prompt: ___ amigos son simpáticos. (Your friends are nice.) [tú]
hint: Tu becomes tus before a plural noun.

prompt: He is a friend of mine. → Es un amigo ___.
hint: Long (stressed) possessive after the noun: mío (masc. sg.).

prompt: ___ padres viven en Valencia. (Her parents live in Valencia.)
hint: Su becomes sus before a plural noun.
